## Zvarr Scout (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
 Zvarr ranger 2  
 CG Medium humanoid (reptilian)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +8  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+4 armor, +3 Dex, +1 natural)  
 **hp** 22 (2d10+2)  
 **Fort** +4, **Ref** +6, **Will** +0  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft.  
 **Melee** shortsword +3 (1d6+3/19–20), kukri +2 (1d4+2/18–20), bite -3 (1d3+2)  
 **Ranged** composite longbow +5 (1d8+2/×3)  
 **Special Attacks** favored enemy (humans +2)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 14, **Dex** 17, **Con** 13, **Int** 10, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 16  
 **Feats** Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +6, Climb +14, Fly +5, Knowledge (geography) +4, Knowledge (nature) +4, Perception +5, Stealth +9, Survival +5  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic  
 **SQ** track +1, wild empathy +2  
 **Gear** masterwork armored longcoat, shortsword, kukri, composite longbow [+2 Str] with 20 arrows
